Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. I can provide a short Q&A now and attach our current subprocessor/location CSV and a simple data-flow diagram. High level answers first, then I'll follow up with a short table + attachments.

High level:
- Primary execution: requests are executed in the region you select at route creation. For GreenBank we can default to the us-east region; we also offer eu-west and ap-southeast for dedicated/private customers.
- KV/cache (session state): stored on-local GPU instance memory and replicated to region-local cache nodes. By default, KV never leaves the region you selected.
- Logs and backups: operational logs (request metadata, error traces) are written to region-local logging pipelines. Backups for model caches and system snapshots are stored encrypted at rest; cross-region replication occurs only if you opt into our disaster-recovery (DR) replication — otherwise backups remain in the same region.
- Subprocessors: I'll attach a current list with country of operation. We use cloud providers (managed infra), a metrics vendor in EU, and a DLP vendor in US for scanning.

I'll attach: redwood_subprocessors_locations_v2.csv, data_flow_kv_and_backups.png.

If you need contractual language (data processing addendum / SCCs or an EU Data Transfer Addendum), I can loop in our Legal team and provide a template.

Best regards,

Elena —

Attaching the CSV export of our subprocessor inventory (column: service, vendor, primary country, purpose). A couple of important clarifications:

- Cache behavior: KV is encrypted in memory and in region-local cache nodes. We use AES-256 in transit and at rest for cache persistence. Cache persistence TTL defaults to 24 hours but is configurable per tenant.
- Model execution: model weights are loaded on the GPU in the region selected; weights are not moved across regions for live inference unless you have configured multi-region mirroring.
- Audit logs: immutable audit logs are written to the same region. We can provide filtered extracts on request for compliance audits.

We also included a simple diagram (data_flow_kv_and_backups.png) showing where backups and longer-term analytics snapshots could be stored if GreenBank enables DR or opt-in analytics exports.

If GreenBank requires that no data leaves the US, you can set the deployment to a US-only policy and opt out of cross-region replication and third-party analytics exports.

Markus Klein

Elena —

Quick answers inline, then next steps.

1) Backups: we support both Redwood-managed keys (default) and customer-managed keys (CMKs) via KMS for Dedicated and Private customers. For GreenBank, we can enable CMKs so backups are encrypted with your key and we do not have key material access.

2) Metrics vendor (DE): receives only aggregated, out-of-band telemetry (no request payloads, no PII). Monitoring vendor (US): collects system-level metrics and error traces; traces are redacted and request payloads are not sent. We can produce an artifact from our privacy team certifying no payloads are shared with those vendors.

3) US-only routing commitment: we can include a clause in the DPA that prevents any cross-border routing of request payloads, KV/cache, logs, and backups unless GreenBank provides explicit written opt-in. This will be part of the data processing addendum we provide for Dedicated/reserved deployments. For hosted/shared tiers, we have more limited guarantees; I'd recommend Dedicated if you need legally binding US-only residency.

Next steps:
- I'll send the DPA draft with the US-only routing clause and an addendum for CMK support; legal (Monica) will own that.
- Please send a signed NDA if you prefer expedited disclosure of the full subprocessor contracts; otherwise the CSV is the canonical list.

I'll loop in Monica to draft the DPA language.

Best,
